# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""rest_push_marketplace.py — 推 cbb-marketplace 仓（空仓特判：无父提交→POST refs）"""
import io, json, os, subprocess, time, pathlib

REPO = "master666-max/cbb-marketplace"
SRC = pathlib.Path(r"D:/zcode专用！！！！危险！！！！！！！！！/正典库构建系统")
TMP = pathlib.Path(r"D:/zcode专用！！！！危险！！！！！！！！！/tools/_rest_mkt_tmp.json")
FILES = [
    (r"cbb-marketplace/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json", ".claude-plugin/marketplace.json"),
    ("cbb-guard/.claude-plugin/plugin.json", "cbb-guard/.claude-plugin/plugin.json"),
    ("cbb-guard/.zcode-plugin/plugin.json", "cbb-guard/.zcode-plugin/plugin.json"),
    ("cbb-guard/hooks/hooks.json", "cbb-guard/hooks/hooks.json"),
    ("cbb-guard/hooks/guard.mjs", "cbb-guard/hooks/guard.mjs"),
    ("cbb-guard/commands/批次自检.md", "cbb-guard/commands/批次自检.md"),
    ("cbb-guard/commands/状态报告.md", "cbb-guard/commands/状态报告.md"),
    ("cbb-guard/commands/覆盖复算.md", "cbb-guard/commands/覆盖复算.md"),
    ("cbb-guard/README.md", "cbb-guard/README.md"),
]


def gh(args, input_file=None):
    cmd = ["gh", "api"] + args
    if input_file:
        cmd += ["--input", str(input_file)]
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"gh fail {' '.join(args[:2])}: {r.stderr[:200]}")
    return json.loads(r.stdout) if r.stdout.strip() else {}


def gh_json(args, payload):
    io.open(TMP, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False))
    return gh(args, input_file=TMP)


for i in range(1, 9):
    try:
        try:
            ref = gh([f"repos/{REPO}/git/refs/heads/main"])
            parent = ref["object"]["sha"]
            base = gh([f"repos/{REPO}/git/commits/{parent}"])["tree"]["sha"]
            parents = [parent]
        except RuntimeError:            # 空仓：无 main 分支
            parent, base, parents = None, None, []
        entries = []
        for local_rel, repo_rel in FILES:
            content = (SRC / pathlib.PurePosixPath(local_rel)).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            blob = gh(["-X", "POST", f"repos/{REPO}/git/blobs",
                       "-f", f"content={content}", "-f", "encoding=utf-8"])
            entries.append({"path": repo_rel, "mode": "100644", "type": "blob", "sha": blob["sha"]})
            print(f"  blob OK {repo_rel} ({len(content)}B)")
        tree_payload = {"tree": entries}
        if base:
            tree_payload["base_tree"] = base
        newtree = gh_json(["-X", "POST", f"repos/{REPO}/git/trees"], tree_payload)
        commit = gh_json(["-X", "POST", f"repos/{REPO}/git/commits"],
                         {"message": "v0.1.0: cbb-guard 守门插件（冻结线原位保全/红区 Write 拦截/账引用旁通/三条中文命令）+ 本地市场定义；guard.mjs 路径可移植（CBB_GUARD_ROOT）",
                          "tree": newtree["sha"], "parents": parents})
        if parent:
            gh_json(["-X", "PATCH", f"repos/{REPO}/git/refs/heads/main"],
                    {"sha": commit["sha"], "force": False})
        else:
            gh_json(["-X", "POST", f"repos/{REPO}/git/refs"],
                    {"ref": "refs/heads/main", "sha": commit["sha"]})
        time.sleep(2)
        chk = gh([f"repos/{REPO}/commits/{commit['sha']}"])
        print(f"✓ 已推送并远端确认 {chk['sha'][:7]}")
        break
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"第{i}轮失败：{str(e)[:160]}；重试")
        time.sleep(4)
else:
    print("✗ 八轮未成功")
